set.body: Make the query-first claim true before Gate 5 certifies it. (1) Factored edge queries: RDM edges are rank-1 tcrossprod(e_i - e_j); represent queries as sparse/factored operators in .effect_form_feature_task (task.R:150-160, kernel.R:976-996) replacing the dense qxq matmul per view; removes the O(q^4) eager matrix (views.R:137; 191MB at q=100, 3.2GB at q=200) and the measured 3.5-3.9x regression vs materialization. (2) Public selected-pairs API: rdm(plan, pairs=) and a compiler path accepting pair_query() (.compiler_query, compiler.R:229-246). (3) Sound memory admission: add live query matrix + validation-memo retention (validation-memo.R:27) to .compiler_memory_plan categories (currently under-reports 3.9x at q=60, 20x at q=100); one gate comparing planned_workspace_bytes to measured peak. (4) Cheap wins: single-pass contrast() on materialized geometry (views.R:51-52 double store read); guard double source_session close (compiler.R:707/886); wire or attic the tested-but-unwired checkpoint/scheduler/.tiled_contraction code. (5) Gate 5 benchmark: benchmarks/run-query-first-scale.R, large-q trial-level, selected edges + RSA coefficients, pair_atoms_materialized receipts, committed results + opt-in test — feeds existing Gate 5 bead bd-01M02MV7DC5W0SKCWSRJ3EJGZ5 and relates to bd-01KZYYQCR3D7NDZQN5DN53AHRC (sampling-covariance per-node cost). Acceptance: rdm(plan) at q=100 is faster than rdm(geometry(plan)); selected-pairs callable without :::; memory gate passing.
set.title: Phase 2: Query-first for real — factored queries, selected pairs, sound memory
